frequency_question: How often does the U.S. penalize major systemic international banks (as opposed to small tier-3/tier-4 entities) for sanctions violations regarding strategic commodities within a given short-term window?
membership_rule: Includes any formal Treasury/OFAC designation or secondary sanction cutting off a top-20 financial institution of a G20 nation for energy/commodity trade violations. Excludes routine fines, warning letters, and penalties against small regional or specialized banks.
